## 

```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(skimr)

```

```{r import temocillin data}
Temocillin_CHEQS <- read_excel("~/R_Projects/CUH_Abx_review/Raw_data/Temocillin/Temocillin_CHEQS.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
filter(!is.na(zone_size))%>% # clear empty panels from testing other MICs 
group_by(specimen_number, susc_test_meth) %>% #keep last record per EUCAST or MIC per specimen
slice(which.max(last_verified)) %>%
ungroup()
```

```{r Skim Temocillin data}
skim(Temocillin_CHEQS)
```

Data extracted from CHEQS - Microbiology results. Result filters set to date from 01/01/2023 to 21/10/26, and component to "TEMOCILLIN\|TEMGN"

There are 19902 individual temocillin records from 18985 specimens and 12498 patients.

```{r comparison table}

Panels = Temocillin_CHEQS %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = susc_test_meth,
              values_from = c(zone_size,susceptibility))%>%
  mutate(ETEST = if_else(is.na(`zone_size_M ETEST`),
                                       0,
                                       1),
         EUCAST = ifelse(is.na(`zone_size_M EUCAST`),
                         0,
                         1),
         Both = ifelse(ETEST == 1 &
                       EUCAST == 1,
                        1,
                        0)
         ) 

Panels %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            `MIC and disc` = sum(Both),
            .by = specimen_type)
  
```

```{r discordance check by specimen type }
library(gt)

lvl <- c("S", "I", "R")

xtab <- Panels %>%
  filter(Both == 1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(`susceptibility_M EUCAST`, `susceptibility_M ETEST`),
                ~ factor(.x, levels = lvl))) %>%
  count(specimen_type, `susceptibility_M EUCAST`, `susceptibility_M ETEST`,
        .drop = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = `susceptibility_M ETEST`,
              names_prefix = "ETEST:",
              values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0)

xtab %>%
  arrange(specimen_type, `susceptibility_M EUCAST`) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "specimen_type",
     rowname_col   = "susceptibility_M EUCAST") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Categorical agreement: EUCAST vs Etest",
             subtitle = "By specimen type") %>%
  #I <-> R mismatches (minor errors)
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#F8D7DA"),
            locations = list(
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:R`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "I"),
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:I`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "R"))) %>%
  tab_stubhead(label = "EUCAST") %>%
  cols_label_with(fn = ~ sub("ETEST:", "", .x)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Etest", columns = starts_with("ETEST:")) %>%
  # shade the agreement diagonal
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#E8F4EA"),
            locations = list(
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:S`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "S"),
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:I`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "I"),
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:R`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "R"))) %>%
  # flag very major errors (EUCAST R, Etest S)
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#F8D7DA"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_body(columns = `ETEST:S`,
                                   rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "R")) %>%
  summary_rows(groups = everything(),
               columns = starts_with("ETEST:"),
               fns = list(Total = ~ sum(.)),
               fmt = ~ fmt_integer(.)) %>%
  tab_options(row_group.font.weight = "bold")
  

```

```{r discordance check by organism}

library(gt)

lvl <- c("S", "I", "R")

xtab <- Panels %>%
  filter(Both == 1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(`susceptibility_M EUCAST`, `susceptibility_M ETEST`),
                ~ factor(.x, levels = lvl))) %>%
  count(organism_or_component, `susceptibility_M EUCAST`, `susceptibility_M ETEST`,
        .drop = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = `susceptibility_M ETEST`,
              names_prefix = "ETEST:",
              values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0)

xtab %>%
  arrange(organism_or_component, `susceptibility_M EUCAST`) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "organism_or_component",
     rowname_col   = "susceptibility_M EUCAST") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Categorical agreement: EUCAST vs Etest",
             subtitle = "By organism") %>%
  tab_stubhead(label = "EUCAST") %>%
  cols_label_with(fn = ~ sub("ETEST:", "", .x)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Etest", columns = starts_with("ETEST:")) %>%
  # shade the agreement diagonal
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#E8F4EA"),
            locations = list(
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:S`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "S"),
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:I`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "I"),
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:R`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "R"))) %>%
  # flag very major errors (EUCAST R, Etest S)
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#F8D7DA"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_body(columns = `ETEST:S`,
                                   rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "R")) %>%
  #I <-> R mismatches (minor errors)
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#F8D7DA"),
            locations = list(
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:R`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "I"),
              cells_body(columns = `ETEST:I`, rows = `susceptibility_M EUCAST` == "R"))) %>%
  summary_rows(groups = everything(),
               columns = starts_with("ETEST:"),
               fns = list(Total = ~ sum(.)),
               fmt = ~ fmt_integer(.)) %>%
  tab_options(row_group.font.weight = "bold")
  
```
